decisions.reason: The LED model, package, and LCSC part selection do not change DCDC1 voltage, current rating, or its normal-operation role.
The selected SK6812 part does not change the standalone USB regulator, activation condition, powered 3.3V loads, source selection, or unresolved regulator-capacity issue.
The LED assembly part specification is unrelated to the battery connector's type, pinout, placement, orientation, accessibility, and NTC contact.
The LED part identification does not alter battery overcharge, overdischarge, thermal sensing, or protection requirements.
The SK6812 manufacturing part selection does not change interboard power connectors, pin matching, board-chain topology, or sensor-board power input pinout.
